<!--
  The top bar of DashboardShell: the brand (when no sidebar carries it), the links (when there is no sidebar),
  an optional search field, and the signed-in person.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ShellNav } from "../blocks/dashboard-shell.types";

export type ShellTopbarProps = {
  nav: ShellNav;
  brand?: "show" | "hide";
  links?: "show" | "hide";
  search?: "show" | "hide";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import SearchPalette from "../components/search-palette.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  nav,
  brand = "show",
  links = "hide",
  search = "show",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ShellTopbarProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="header"
    class="flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center gap-6 border-b border-border bg-background px-6"
    data-testid="topbar"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Group v-if="((brand as string) === 'show')" gap="2" align="center" class="shrink-0" data-testid="brand">
      <LucideIcon name="layers" :size="24" />
      <Text size="base" weight="bold" :class="(true ? '' : 'sr-only')">
        {{ nav.brand }}
      </Text>
    </Group>
    <NavBlock v-if="((links as string) === 'show')"
      :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', nav.label, landmarkLabel)) : nav.label)"
      class="hidden lg:block"
    >
      <List class="m-0 flex list-none items-center gap-2 p-0">
        <ListItem v-for="l in nav.links" :key="l.id">
          <Link
            href="#/"
            variant="default"
            size="sm"
            :aria-current="((l.id === nav.current) ? 'page' : undefined)"
            :class="cn(
              'flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2',
              (true ? 'px-4' : 'justify-center px-2'),
              ((l.id === nav.current) ? 'bg-muted font-medium' : '')
            )"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <LucideIcon :name="l.icon" :size="16" />
            <Inline :class="(true ? '' : 'sr-only')">
              {{ l.name }}
            </Inline>
          </Link>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </NavBlock>
    <template v-if="((search as string) === 'show')">
      <Box v-if="((links as string) === 'show')" class="ml-auto hidden w-64 shrink-0 xl:block">
        <SearchPalette :label="nav.search" :shortcut="nav.shortcut" />
      </Box>
      <SearchPalette v-else :label="nav.search" :shortcut="nav.shortcut" />
    </template>
    <Group
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      :class="
        ((links as string) === 'show') && ((search as string) === 'show') ? 'shrink-0'
        : 'ml-auto shrink-0'
      "
      data-testid="user"
    >
      <LucideIcon name="bell" :size="20" class="text-muted-foreground" />
      <MediaFrame :alt="nav.userName" ratio="1/1" class="size-8 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
    </Group>
  </Block>
</template>
